entries.bdbd66a8239e2a85: This business operates the food supermarket "Maxvalu" and the small-format "Maxvalu Express" in 7 prefectures: Shizuoka, Aichi, Mie, Gifu, Shiga, Kanagawa and Yamanashi. As of February 28, 2026, there were 249 stores, concentrated in the Tokai region, with 109 in Shizuoka Prefecture, 61 in Aichi Prefecture and 48 in Mie Prefecture. The consolidated subsidiary Delica Foods Co.,Ltd. manufactures sushi, cooked rice, prepared dishes and more. The Group has a single reportable segment, and operating revenue for the fiscal year ended February 2026 was ¥384,951 million.
